description: This file defines the 'PayPeriod' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing pay period records in the database with ORM annotations. It includes properties for pay period code and name, along with getters and setters.

classes.name: PayPeriod
classes.description: An ORM entity representing a pay period, mapped to the 'hs_hr_payperiod' table in the database.
